zh.name: 顺风而行
zh.description:
迦娜的友军在朝她移动时获得移动速度。

迦娜的普攻和【和风守护】会附带一部分额外移动速度的额外魔法伤害。

en.name: Tailwind
en.description:
Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her.

Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.

zh.name: 飓风呼啸
zh.description: 迦娜改变气压和温度，在目标区域召唤小型风暴，风暴体积随时间增大。她可以再次施放该技能来释放风暴。风暴会朝向施放方向飞行，对沿途的所有单位造成伤害和击飞效果。
zh.tooltip: 迦娜召唤一道在{{ maxduration }}秒里持续聚集的飓风，随后沿路猛刮出去。飓风对目标造成<magicDamage>{{ minimumdamage }} - {{ maxdamage }}魔法伤害</magicDamage>和{{ baseknockup }} - {{ maxknockup }}秒<status>击飞</status>。移动距离、伤害和<status>击飞</status>时长都基于飓风聚集的时长。迦娜可以<recast>再次施放</recast>来提前将飓风刮出去。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

en.name: Howling Gale
en.description: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can activate the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.
en.tooltip: Janna summons a tornado that grows stronger over {{ maxduration }} seconds then blows along its path. It deals <magicDamage>{{ minimumdamage }} - {{ maxdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Knocks Up</status> for {{ baseknockup }} - {{ maxknockup }} seconds. The distance, damage, and <status>Knock Up</status> duration increase based on how much the tornado grew. Janna can <recast>Recast</recast> to send the tornado early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

zh.name: 和风守护
zh.description: 迦娜召唤出一个空气元素灵体，来被动地提升她的移动速度，并使她能够穿越单位。她也可以主动激活这个技能，来对一个敌人造成伤害和减速效果。
zh.tooltip:
被动：迦娜获得{{ totalms }}移动速度并处在幽灵状态。

主动：迦娜的风灵打击一名敌人，对其造成持续{{ slowduration }}秒的{{ totalslow }}减速和{{ totaldamage }} + {{ spell.tailwindself:bonusdamage }}魔法伤害。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

en.name: Zephyr
en.description: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Move Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Move Speed.
en.tooltip:
Passive: Janna gains {{ totalms }} Move Speed and is Ghosted.

Active: Janna's elemental strikes an enemy, Slowing them by {{ totalslow }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds, and dealing {{ totaldamage }} + {{ spell.tailwindself:bonusdamage }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

zh.name: 风暴之眼
zh.description: 迦娜制造出一阵防御性的气旋，来为目标友军或防御塔吸收即将到来的伤害，并提高目标的攻击力。
zh.tooltip:
迦娜为一个友军或防御塔提供持续{{ shieldduration }}秒的{{ totalshield }}护盾值。在护盾存在时，该友军目标获得{{ totalad }}攻击力。

迦娜在每次用一个技能使一名敌方英雄的移动速度受损时，会使这个冷却时间缩短{{ ecdrefundforcc*100 }}%。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

en.name: Eye Of The Storm
en.description: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.
en.tooltip:
Janna grants an ally champion or turret {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. While shielded, they gain {{ totalad }} Attack Damage.

Janna refunds {{ ecdrefundforcc*100 }}% of the cooldown whenever she impairs an enemy champion's movement with an Ability.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

zh.name: 复苏季风
zh.description: 迦娜召唤魔法风暴围绕自己，将敌人击退。在风暴平息后，当技能仍处在激活状态时，和风将治疗附近的友军。
zh.tooltip: 迦娜召唤一阵魔法季风，<status>击退</status>附近的敌人们然后在{{ duration }}秒里持续治疗附近的友军共<healing>{{ totalheal }}生命值</healing>。移动或使用技能都会提前结束这阵季风。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

en.name: Monsoon
en.description: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.
en.tooltip: Janna summons a magical monsoon, <status>Knocking Back</status> nearby enemies then healing nearby allies for <healing>{{ totalheal }} Health</healing> over {{ duration }} seconds. Moving or using an Ability ends the monsoon early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

zh.name: 皮克斯，仙灵伙伴
zh.description: 每当皮克斯正在跟随的英雄进行攻击时，皮克斯就会发射魔法飞弹。这些飞弹会自动寻敌，但也会被其它单位所拦截。

en.description: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.

zh.description: 璐璐和皮克斯各自发射一个穿刺飞弹，对命中的所有敌人造成伤害和重度减速效果。
zh.tooltip:
璐璐和皮克斯各发射一束贯穿魔弹，造成{{ totaldamage }}魔法伤害和在{{ slowduration }}秒里持续衰减的{{ slowamount*-100 }}%减速。

如果两束魔弹都命中了相同的一名敌人，那么会对其造成额外的{{ bonusmissiledamage }}魔法伤害。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

en.name: Glitterlance
en.description: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.
en.tooltip:
Lulu and Pix each fire a piercing bolt dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*-100 }}%, decaying over {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Enemies take {{ bonusmissiledamage }} magic damage from additional bolts.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

zh.name: 奇思妙想
zh.description: 如果对友军施放，会暂时增加目标友军的攻击速度和移动速度。如果对敌人施放，会将一名敌方英雄变成可爱的动物，使其无法攻击或施法。
zh.tooltip:
当用在一名友方身上时，璐璐提供{{ totalms }}移动速度和{{ asbonus*100 }}%攻击速度，持续{{ msduration }}秒。

当用在一名敌人身上时，璐璐会将其变形{{ ccduration }}秒。 {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

en.name: Whimsy
en.description: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.
en.tooltip:
When used on an ally, Lulu grants {{ totalms }} Move Speed and {{ asbonus*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ msduration }} seconds.

When used on an enemy, Lulu Polymorphs them for {{ ccduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

zh.name: 帮忙，皮克斯！
zh.description: 如果对友军施放，会命令皮克斯跳到一名友军身上进行保护，之后会跟随并协助目标（而不是璐璐）进行攻击。如果对敌人施放，皮克斯会跳到敌人身上造成伤害，之后会跟随并提供目标的视野。
zh.tooltip:
在对一名友方施放时，皮克斯会跳到该友方处并提供持续{{ pixonallyduration }}秒的皮克斯，仙灵伙伴。如果该友方是一名英雄，那么皮克斯还会提供持续{{ shieldduration }}秒的{{ totalshield }}护盾值。

在对一名敌方英雄使用时，皮克斯会妨碍该英雄，造成{{ totaldamage }}魔法伤害，并提供其真实视野，持续{{ pixonenemyduration }}秒。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

en.name: Help, Pix!
en.description: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.
en.tooltip:
When used on an ally, Pix jumps to them and grants Pix, Faerie Companion for {{ pixonallyduration }} seconds. If the ally is a champion, Pix also grants {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.

When used on an enemy champion, Pix hampers them, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and granting True Sight of them for {{ pixonenemyduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

zh.description: 璐璐让她的友军变大，击飞目标附近的敌人，同时为她的友军提供大量生命值加成。接下来的数秒内，该友军会获得一个减少附近敌人速度的光环。
zh.tooltip: 璐璐使一名友方英雄巨大化，并<status>击飞</status>周围的敌人{{ knockbackduration }}秒。巨大化的友方英雄会获得<healing>{{ totalbonushealth }}最大生命值</healing>并使周围的敌人们<status>减速</status>{{ slowpercent }}%，持续{{ buffduration }}秒。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

en.description: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.

The enlarged ally gains <healing>{{ totalbonushealth }} max Health</healing> and <status>Slows</status> surrounding enemies by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ buffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

zh.name: 冲击之潮
zh.description: 释放一股在友方英雄和敌方英雄之间交替流动的水流，治疗友军并伤害敌军。
zh.tooltip:
娜美释放一股在友方英雄和敌方英雄之间交替弹跳的水流。每个目标只会被弹到一次，并且水流至多可弹{{ maxtargets }}个目标。

  • 对敌方英雄造成{{ totaldamage }}魔法伤害并弹向附近的一名友方英雄身上。
    每次弹跳会使伤害和治疗数额修正{{ bouncescaling }}。 {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

en.name: Ebb and Flow
en.description: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.
en.tooltip:
Nami unleashes a stream of water that bounces between allied and enemy champions. Each champion can only be hit once, and it hits up to {{ maxtargets }} targets.
  • Restores {{ totalheal }} Health to allies and will bounce to a nearby enemy champion.
  • Deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to enemies and will bounce to a nearby allied champion.
    The damage and healing value is modified by {{ bouncescaling }} each bounce. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Allies hit by the wave gain double the effect of Surging Tides.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
